| Line # | `TeamNotes.txt` content | `ideas.txt` content | Difference |
|--------|-------------------------|---------------------|------------|
| 1 | `Team Notes - Fresh Ideas` | *(no line – file starts with the next line)* | **Header** – `TeamNotes.txt` begins with a descriptive title that `ideas.txt` lacks. |
| 2 | `Collaboration leads to success. Innovation ignites growth.` | `Collaboration leads to success. Innovation ignites growth.` | **Same text** – both files contain this line verbatim. |
| 3 | *(file ends)* | *(file ends)* | **Line count** – `TeamNotes.txt` has 2 lines, `ideas.txt` has only 1. |

**Summary of distinctions**

1. **Header line** – `TeamNotes.txt` includes a header (`Team Notes - Fresh Ideas`) that provides context and is absent in `ideas.txt`.
